$comment: retryUnstampedOnce: a prepare that ends without stamping the card for an unrecognised reason is re-dispatched once automatically; a second unstamped ending parks the card on the operator queue (needs-you) with both reasons. autoSize: a card held no-size (a task with no estimatedLoc, a story with no size) is routed to the item prepare, which authors the size/estimate from its touch set. Cascade: standard true → platform prepare → this file → env WE_PREPARE_RETRY_UNSTAMPED_ONCE / WE_PREPARE_AUTO_SIZE.
